ns2:section.sectionText: This course will engage students in an interdisciplinary exploration of the role of slavery and the slave trade world in U.S. history. Central to the course will be examining the debate over the number of Africans enslaved, but also on the economic significance of the slave trade and slavery?the political economy of the slave(ry) trade?in the broader interpretation of capitalist development in the Atlantic world from the to the 17th to the 19th centuries.
